text: The Lion lunges in and tries to bite at the Hippopotamus, but the great animal keeps pushing forward.
The Hippopotamus charges across the riverbank, closing distance on the Lion with heavy, determined strides.
The Rhinoceros lowers its head and surges forward in a heavy, determined charge across the grass.
The Lion lunges sideways, reaching for the shark but missing in the murky water.
The Gorilla stands tall and beats its chest, squaring off against the Grizzly bear on open ground.
The first shark snaps its jaws toward the rival's flank, missing by a whisker.
